subcategories.name: White blend
subcategories.note: Tasting Notes: Melons and lemon standard choices, white fruit flavours balanced with citrus acidity. Pairs with: Calamari, Snails.

subcategories.name: Chenin blanc
subcategories.note: Tasting Notes: Imagine walking into a field of wild flowers. How about 3 apples, 2 peaches and a melon? Pairs with: Our vegetarian dishes or Hake.

subcategories.name: Chardonnay
subcategories.note: Tasting Notes: Flavours of citrus-pear and light lemon with real lime around you. Pairs with: Anything in our Creamy Chicken Curry.

subcategories.name: Sauvignon blanc
subcategories.note: Tasting Notes: Tastes like a tropical island adventure, with the top note of passionfruit on the finish. Pairs with: Calamari, Prawns, Fish, Chicken.

subcategories.name: Sparkling & prosecco
subcategories.note: Tasting Notes: Tastes like a sugar crush on soft layers of angles. Pairs with: Anything Celebrated.

items.name: Prosecco Della Italia Principessa Black Bottle

subcategories.name: Sweet range
subcategories.note: Tasting Notes: An exotic, smooth, fruit-forward wonder. Riding the ocean waves. Pairs with: Desserts or Chicken.

subcategories.name: Cabernet sauvignon
subcategories.note: Tasting Notes: Warm and full tone on a cold winter night, enjoying the spice of black cherry and pepper. Pairs with: Peri-Peri Chicken, Steak or Beef Mozambik.

subcategories.name: Merlot
subcategories.note: Tasting Notes: Notice the bitter-smooth flavor of dark fruits, plum and ripe berries. Pairs with: Mozambik Steak, Half or Full Chicken.

subcategories.name: Pinotage
subcategories.note: Tasting Notes: Notes of ripe mulberry with a crisp essence blended to vanilla and rich coffee elements. Pairs with: Red Meat, or Grilled Pork Ribs or any of our Curry Specialties.

subcategories.name: Shiraz
subcategories.note: Tasting Notes: Robust, rich and bold; structured flavours of ripe plum, spice, blackberries, dark cherries and cocoa. Pairs with: Tough Mozambik Red Star Full Chicken or Ribs.

subcategories.name: Blend
subcategories.note: Tasting Notes: Perfect balanced sweetness spiced with fine oak relevance and vanilla. Pairs with: Steaks, Ribs or any Mozambik Specialties.
